{{Quote|(I'm) the only felon in the galaxy who'll have to set up an employee pension plan.|[[Klaus Vandangante/Legends|Doc]]|<ref name="HSSE" />}}
'''Vandangante outlaw techs''' were a roving band of well-equipped and well-trained [[Outlaw tech/Legends|outlaw technicians]], led by [[Klaus Vandangante/Legends|Klaus 'Doc' Vandangante]] and his daughter [[Jessa Vandangante|Jessa]]. They made their living by illegally repairing and modifying [[Starship/Legends|starships]] for fugitives of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], organized crime, and were political opponents of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]].<ref name="AGttSWU(1E)">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]''</ref>

==History==
Doc and his techs had been sought by Authority and other official forces for years, but never apprehended. They had kept themselves well insulated, channeled into as many crooked bureaucrats and scuttlebutt sources as possible. More than one strike unit had moved against one of Doc's outlaw tech bases, only to seize a target area empty of everything but abandoned buildings and useless junk.<ref name="HSSE">''[[Han Solo at Stars' End]]''</ref>

==Facilities==
[[File:Doc-bio.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Doc]]
Doc had an operation that was well known to lawbreakers throughout the galaxy. His techs repaired vehicles that had been in [[Lightfight|firefights]] and changed the ID profile and appearance of vessels... with no questions asked. Doc even bought and sold stolen pieces of major hardware and also hijacked [[Drone barge/Legends|drone barges]] in flight for the salvage. In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], a number of [[Gender/Legends|males]], females, [[Human/Legends|humans]], and [[Non-huMan|non-humans]], along with a large assortment of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and other automata, made up Doc and Jessa's band of outlaws.<ref name="HSSE" />Repair, modification, and salvage included equipping space vessels with heavy armament, sophisticated [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] arrays, military-rated [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]], [[Hyperdrive/Legends|superlight]]-speed engines, or any combination thereof. The Vandangante outlaw techs frequently moved from [[Star system/Legends|system]] to system to elude patrols and evade capture, while they kept their whereabouts a secret.<ref name="AGttSWU(1E)" />If something was needed with machinery and his rigorous background check was met, Doc and his techs could do it.<ref name="HSSE" />
